sections.label: First Budget of new term
sections.summary: This is the first Budget in this new term of Parliament, the largest annual Budget to date, passed amid a changed and uncertain world.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This being the first Budget in this new term of Parliament, I should explain for the benefit of first-time Members that it is customary at the end of the annual Budget process for the Leader of the House to deliver a speech in acknowledgment of the Chair of the proceedings, namely, Mr Speaker.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This is our largest annual Budget to date, passed against the backdrop of a profoundly changed and uncertain world.

sections.label: Total fertility rate spotlight
sections.summary: Budget 2026 highlighted the total fertility rate, which dropped to a historic low of 0.87, signalling a marriage and parenthood reset.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Budget 2026 also put a spotlight on our total fertility rate (TFR), which has dropped to a historic low of 0.87 and signals the start of the marriage and parenthood reset as a whole-of-nation effort.

sections.label: Projected FY2025 surplus
sections.summary: This approach has stood Singapore in good stead, with a projected healthy surplus of $15.1 billion for FY2025.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This approach has stood us in good stead.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We have projected a healthy surplus of $15.1 billion for financial year (FY) 2025.

sections.label: US Supreme Court strikes tariffs
sections.summary: On 20 February, eight days after the Budget Statement, the US Supreme Court struck down President Trump's Liberation Day tariffs.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: On 20 February, eight days after the Budget Statement, the US Supreme Court struck down President Trump's Liberation Day tariffs.

sections.label: Budget debate participation details
sections.summary: Safeguarding the model requires the right laws, principles and people, and this year's Budget had nine days of debate with 68 Members speaking.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To safeguard it we must have the right laws, the right principles and the right people.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: It is important to appreciate that not only is our model unique but that it is this uniqueness that has enabled the Government to continue delivering Budgets that strengthen our economy, improve the lives of Singaporeans and bring Singapore forward.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For this year, we had robust debate spanning nine days; 68 Members spoke for two and a half days in the debate on the Budget Statement, the highest number in recent Budgets with about 21 hours of debate; 425 cuts were covered over six days of Committee of Supply, with almost 55 hours of debate.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: And for the first time in my recollection, there was no formal break in the Budget process.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This year, you have added a new item to your toolkit to keep us on time and in line – the bell and the mute button.

sections.label: Longer debate with more Members
sections.summary: With more Members in the 15th Parliament, this year's Budget and Committee of Supply debate took 12% more time than last year despite fewer cuts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: With more Members in this 15th Parliament, the total time that we needed for this year’s Budget and Committee of Supply debate was 12% more than last year, even though the number of cuts were fewer, by about a third.

sections.label: Unanimous support for Budget 2026
sections.summary: Both sides of the House gave unanimous support for Budget 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: First, there was unanimous support from both sides of the House for Budget 2026.

sections.label: Speaker's personal sitting record
sections.summary: The speaker set a personal record by sitting in the same seat for six hours and 10 minutes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Having said that, I established a new personal record for myself  , by being in the same seat for a good six hours and 10 minutes  , a record I hope I do not never need to break again.

sections.label: Singapore bracing for volatility
sections.summary: Singapore must brace for greater volatility, and Members of the 15th Parliament must commit to doing what is best for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Whilst we have been able to navigate well over the last six decades, but as Prime Minister has reminded us, Singapore must brace for greater volatility and unpredictability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: As Senior Minister of State Murali Pillai said yesterday, our history as a small island nation has given us a “particular prosperity”, a “prosperity that can remain ours as long as we preserve and grow our courage and ability to navigate the high seas”.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Let us remember that this “particular prosperity” has been earned through the hard work, sacrifice and a deep sense of duty of all Singaporeans to one another.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: As Members of this 15th Parliament, whatever storms may range on the high seas or up in the skies, let us keep our eyes on the horizon that is the Singaporean people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: We must leave the world in no doubt of our commitment to do what is best for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Only then, can we secure our future together in a changed world.
